description: Na₂V₂O₅ is Chalcostibite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.56 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.99 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with five VO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.46 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.46 Å. There are four inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three VO₄ tetrahedra and  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.73-1.88 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three VO₄ tetrahedra and corners with three equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.75-1.87 Å. In the third V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three VO₄ tetrahedra and  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.75-1.87 Å. In the fourth V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing VO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.73-1.87 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two V atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two V atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four Na and one V atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two V atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one V atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one V atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two V atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one V atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two V atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two V atoms.
